dedupe_keys.name: new caledonia electricity generation facilities 69 plants with type capacity fuel and status and large dams under safety regulation dimenc georep

description: The New Caledonia industry, mines and energy directorate (DIMENC) publishes two infrastructure layers on the government's Géorep platform. Contents: 69 electricity generation facilities with name, type (thermal, hydro, wind, solar and others), installed capacity (for example the Doniambo heavy fuel oil plant with four 40 MW units and the Ducos kerosene turbines), fuel, operating status and province, taken from the operating authorisation files that project developers submit; and the large dams of New Caledonia, five structures regulated under the dam safety rules transposed from French law (decree 2015-526), with data from operators' regulatory returns and inspection findings. Producer: DIMENC, with the energy observatory cited as source for the plants. Coverage: the whole of New Caledonia. Format and access: ArcGIS feature services with query and export through the Géorep hub, without registration. Licence: Licence Ouverte (Etalab open licence). Caveats: the power plant layer's lineage notes an update in May 2018, so newer solar farms and plant closures may be missing; the grid itself (lines and substations) is not published. Simulation uses: island power system models with the generation mix, exposure of plants and dams to cyclones and floods, and dam-break hazard screening downstream of the five large dams. Related records: the BDROUTE-NC road network (data-new-caledonia-bdroute-nc-road-network-and-traffic-counts) and the DIMENC mining cadastre (data-new-caledonia-dimenc-mining-cadastre) come from the same platform.
